message:
The build environment has a different path. Let me check what's available in the build environment.

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace && bash build.sh 'pwd && ls / && ls /src 2>/dev/null; ls /work 2>/dev/null; find / -maxdepth 3 -name "*.c" -path "*xml*" 2>/dev/null | head -20' 2>&1 | head -50</parameter>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
